entities.name: Haloferax volcanii SRP19 (D4GW40)
observations: Exact 92-aa sequence match to reviewed UniProt D4GW40; predicted molecular mass 10.16 kDa and theoretical pI 4.92.
SRP19 Pfam domain PF01922 spans residues 5–86 (i-Evalue 1.7e-24).
SRP component; binds 7S RNA and mediates binding of the SRP 54-kDa subunit.

entities.name: SRP-dependent membrane targeting
observations: Reference annotation assigns SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane and signal-sequence recognition (GO:0006617).

entities.name: Cytoplasm / SRP
observations: Reference protein is annotated to the cytoplasm and signal recognition particle (GO:0048500).

entities.name: 7S RNA binding
observations: Reference annotation assigns 7S RNA binding (GO:0008312); SRP19 also mediates association of the SRP 54-kDa subunit.
